subject: Final-mile commit verification and ARR narrative asks
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final-mile commit verification and ARR narrative asks

Team — final sweep for the investor board packet. We need an evidence-backed, reconciled view of ARR and bookings for the July 18 board deck. Please read and action the bullets below by EOD today (internal deadline) so I can assemble the evidence pack tomorrow morning.

Key asks (prioritized):
- Confirm stage + commit status for every open opportunity > $75k in HubSpot (deal owner, latest activity date, expected close date, and whether legal/procurement hold exists). If any deal is NOT in HubSpot, flag now and attach the supporting email thread.
- For deals marked as "Commit": include the piece of evidence (signed SOW, confirmed PO email, DocuSign link). Add to the "evidence pack" folder and list filename in your reply.
- Surface any bookings that move from commit -> commit at risk (reason and mitigation).
- Provide a short one-line impact to ARR if the deal slips past FY close.

Attachments I pulled into Drive (please add or update): evidence_pack_q2.xlsx (summary tab), pipeline_export_2028-07-08.csv (raw export). I will drop a consolidated PDF to the board packet drive once you confirm.

Urgency/context: The CFO asked for a traceable path from the deck numbers -> raw evidence for 10 material deals we call out. We should assume auditors/VCs will ask for receipts for any commit called out in the ARR corridor.

Format for replies (paste in thread):
- Deal: <HubSpot ID / short name>
- Owner: <name>
- Stage: <stage> (Commit/Commit at Risk/Forecast/Best Case)
- Evidence: <filename or link>
- Close Date (current): <YYYY-MM-DD>
- ARR impact if slips: <$ amount>
- Quick note (1-2 sentences)

Thanks — I know this is a tight cycle. If you hit any blockers with customers (legal or procurement stalls) ping me and I will escalate.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final-mile commit verification and ARR narrative asks

On Mon, Jul 9, 2028 at 9:12 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team — final sweep for the investor board packet. We need an evidence-backed, reconciled view of ARR and bookings for the July 18 board deck. Please read and action the bullets below by EOD today (internal deadline) so I can assemble the evidence pack tomorrow morning.

I ran the >$75k filter and attached a quick pass to pipeline_export_2028-07-08.csv (added a comment column for my calls). I have 6 deals that look like solid commit and 2 that I have flagged as "commit at risk" because procurement requested contract redlines this morning.

I'll paste the prioritized list below (first 3 are material to ARR corridor):
- Deal: BHL-3421 / Brightline Health
  - Owner: Ben Carter
  - Stage: Commit
  - Evidence: SOW_BHL-3421_signed.pdf (uploaded to evidence folder), DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/rooms/rooms1234
  - Close Date (current): 2028-07-15
  - ARR impact if slips: $162,000
  - Quick note: Legal completed markup; procurement has one last Q on data residency clause — reaching out now to close.

- Deal: CLN-887 / Clearline Labs
  - Owner: Ben Carter
  - Stage: Commit at Risk
  - Evidence: PO_pending (email thread flagged), attached export comment
  - Close Date (current): 2028-07-22
  - ARR impact if slips: $96,500
  - Quick note: procurement delaying PO due to internal approval calendar.

I'll push updates (HubSpot notes + evidence links) as I hear back this afternoon. If you need me to escalate Brightline procurement, tell me who I should loop in.

— Ben
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 13:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final-mile commit verification and ARR narrative asks

Thanks Ben — great color. I reconciled bookings and updated two items in the export: added the evidence file names and moved one deal from Forecast -> Commit after legal confirmation. I uploaded the updated evidence pack (evidence_pack_q2_v2.xlsx) to the drive and appended the change log.

Summary of material changes I made:
- Increased confirmed bookings in the July corridor by $248,000 (includes BHL-3421).
- Marked CLN-887 as Commit at Risk (procurement timing).
- Removed one duplicate pipeline row (internal CRM dedupe).

Specific ask for Hannah: Please confirm whether the board narrative should call out BHL-3421 as "Board-Confirmed Commit: evidence on file" or "Pending-signature commit". My recommendation is to call it Board-Confirmed Commit given signed SOW + DocuSign room, but if the legal hold on the data residency clause is material we should add a one-liner.

Files added: evidence_pack_q2_v2.xlsx (summary + evidence links), pipeline_export_2028-07-08_clean.csv

— Vanessa
Head of Revenue Strategy | Redwood Inference

From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@brightlinehealth.com>

Cc: Procurement <procurement@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 16:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final-mile commit verification and ARR narrative asks

Hi Ben / Hannah — thanks for the update and for sending the SOW. Procurement here — we confirm Brightline will execute the DocuSign by EOD Thursday (7/12). The procurement team has one follow-up question on the data residency paragraph (we asked for a short clarification, not a substantive change). Once the clarification is posted we will complete execution.

DocuSign room link: https://www.docusign.com/rooms/rooms1234
Internal PO/approval ETA: 7/18 (we expect signatures sooner but putting the PO on the 7/18 calendar as the conservative date).

If Redwood prefers the deal to be treated as "Board-Confirmed Commit" for the packet because the SOW is signed and DocuSign room is active, feel free to do so — procurement will confirm execution in writing when the DocuSign completes.

--
Maria Gonzalez
Head of Vendor Management | Brightline Health
